artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: PORTAL repo, branch wk-irpt_fntend-2-2-fe-s-13, commit fb3339df (LOCAL). Eleven GENERATED wire types, one per producer schema at infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_contracts/ @33351469c2, plus index.ts re-exporting them with WIRE_SCHEMA_PINS (schema name -> sha256 of the schema FILE). Generated by __tests__/fe-s-13/gen-wire.ts (`bun run` it from the portal root; output committed, never regenerated by a test -- a test that regenerated its own input would certify the generator against itself). Each file's header carries its source path and that sha256. Field names are the schema's own snake_case, enums are string-literal unions, arrays are readonly.

PORTAL repo, commit fb3339df (LOCAL). Ten wire->view adapters (adaptDirectoryEntry .. adaptStatusEnvelope; RenderPackage is the PRODUCED one and no adapter is claimed for it) and the two view->wire request shapes: toAnalysisGenerateWire (the seven-key Generate body, with ANALYSIS_GENERATE_KEYS stated once) and toExportBundleWire. FIELD_MAP names all 150 fields of the ten view types with the wire path each comes from and one of exactly three kinds -- RENAME, RESTRUCTURE, CARRIED-AS-IS. There is no DERIVED member. A view field the wire does not carry takes that field's own explicit unknown (null / 'unknown' / 'UNCERTAIN' / [] / the non-asserting false) and is marked WIRE_ABSENT with its reason; wireEnvelope states that rule once for the five envelope members rather than ten times in ten adapters.

PORTAL repo, commit fb3339df (LOCAL). IR_ROUTE_TABLE is routes.json @bef9b459f3: twelve rows carrying operation, method, pathTemplate, pathParams, binding and status, where `${method} ${pathTemplate}` IS each row's route_key -- eleven DECLARED, one NO-HANDLER-AT-HEAD. irBuildRequest binds path parameters, puts a GET's values in the query and a POST's in a JSON body, and REFUSES to build a route whose path parameter is missing. LiveClient.send builds exactly that method and path and runs the payload through contracts/adapt.ts, so both implementations take one code path from wire to view. Typed refusals: NoDeclaredRoute (analysis-requests, export-preview) and NotYetExercisable (holdings). irKey, clearProtected, handleIrResponse, the revocation rules and the telemetry redaction are unchanged. FixtureAdapter now detects a PRODUCER fixture (the `_fixture` + `instance` pair) and serves it through the same adapters.

PORTAL repo, commit d7b3d615 (LOCAL). The eleven producer .valid.json copied BYTE-FOR-BYTE from _contracts/fixtures/ (sha256 equality asserted against the source at test time, both sides read from disk); eleven request records under requests/, one per DECLARED route, with the producer fixtures' own ids bound and the paths built by the client's own irBuildRequest; and no-declared-route.envelope.json, the envelope the RequestList renders when no route serves a request list.

PORTAL repo, commit d7b3d615 (LOCAL). Eight keys, every one a DECLARED path or declared-path prefix (the instrument matches a request URL by LONGEST KEY SUBSTRING), each serving a WIRE-shaped body built from the producer fixtures: directory/resolve, directory/search, performance/, holdings/, analysis/, narrative/, status, export/.

PORTAL repo, commit d7b3d615 (LOCAL). PORTAL repo, commit 3a8a3959 (LOCAL). THE FIVE CONSUMER FILES CHANGED, named: (1) RequestList.tsx -- additive optional `envelope` prop; an UNAVAILABLE envelope renders the state and its public reason code instead of the row list. (2) AnalysisTab.tsx -- catches the typed NoDeclaredRoute and hands RequestList that envelope with reason code `no-declared-route`; the ONLY view that renders it. (3) resolveBundle.ts -- composeExportBundle, the client-side composition that replaces the absent preview route. (4) Preview.tsx -- runPreview falls back to that composition on NoDeclaredRoute and only on it. (5) submit.ts -- buildSubmitRequest takes an OPTIONAL sixth argument, the composed bundle, carried as the producer-shaped wireBundle that IS the body of POST .../export. No view TYPE changed, so no other consumer of the view types needed an edit.

PORTAL repo, commit 3a8a3959 (LOCAL). The round-1 negatives are unchanged (late-response drop, the 401/403 clear of every protected key for the scope AND NO OTHER, telemetry redaction). declared_exclusions.item: Deleting `previewExportBundle` and `listAnalysisRequests` from InvestorReportingApi, and repointing the FixtureAdapter's call-log URLs onto the declared paths
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of grant, and it would make F13-AC1 and F13-AC10 unreachable. Seven test files in FIVE folders this order does not name (fe-s-2, fe-s-3, fe-s-6, fe-s-9 x2, fe-s-10) bind those members and the round-1 path literals -- measured and enumerated in row IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S16. The LIVE plane speaks only the route table and refuses both operations by name (F13-AC8); the two members remain as retired members the FIXTURE plane answers.

declared_exclusions.item: Dropping any field from the view types in contracts/index.ts
declared_exclusions.reason: The order permits dropping a view field the wire does not carry OR filling it with the envelope's explicit unknown. Filling was chosen for every such field: the view types are consumed by ~9,000 lines under pages/InvestorReporting/ and by test folders outside this grant, and fe-s-3/source-bounds.test.ts asserts as a POSITIVE CONTROL that eleven named return-bearing field names are still present in contracts/index.ts. Every fill is named WIRE_ABSENT in FIELD_MAP with its reason, so nothing is hidden by the choice.

declared_exclusions.item: Computing withheldCapabilities, promoting a storage key to a download route, or building a BenchmarkFact from the producer's unstructured benchmark object
declared_exclusions.reason: Each would be arithmetic or an inference, which the cell forbids verbatim. All three are carried as explicit unknowns and recorded in row IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S17; (d) in that row is the one with a product consequence for the counterpart.

declared_exclusions.item: Editing the fe-s-1 / fe-s-3 / fe-s-7 ambient shims, or tsconfig
declared_exclusions.reason: The face states the shims are not edited. fe-s-13 adds its OWN ambient-shims.d.ts declaring only what its generators and tests need (writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, node:crypto's createHash) -- the same additive pattern fe-s-3 and fe-s-7 already use, since TypeScript merges same-named declare-module bodies.

declared_exclusions.item: Changing what the Holdings tab shows when the live client refuses its route
declared_exclusions.reason: The cell names exactly ONE view that renders the no-route envelope -- the RequestList in the Analysis tab -- and says 'nothing else'. HoldingsTab's existing round-1 catch maps the refusal to its REQUEST_FAILED envelope; changing that is a later cell's act, not this one's.

surprises: IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S16: the face orders the two no-route operations RETIRED from InvestorReportingApi and says only __tests__/fe-s-1/ needs updating, but seven test files in five folders outside this order's grant bind those members and the round-1 path literals -- so the live plane was moved onto the route table while the two members stayed as retired, fixture-plane-only members. The cost is named in the row: an assertion on the FixtureAdapter's call log no longer proves anything about the live path.

IRPT_FNTEND-W1-S17: five places where the producer's contract and the view type do not map 1:1 -- three closed vocabularies lose a value inbound, AnalysisReport's protected artifact carries a SERVER-ONLY storage key where the view requires an authorized route (so it adapts to null), and PerformanceReport's benchmark fact is an unstructured object the view's BenchmarkFact cannot be built from. Each is filled with that field's explicit unknown and named in FIELD_MAP. The row also records that no versioned contract artifact exists in the worktree, so the two RAW pins are the authority.
